metric: synthetic Enter or scroll dispatch to matching GPU completion callback; not physical key-to-photon latency
presentation_timestamp_limitation: Initial probe trials returned zero timestamps. All six formal runs reported positive presentation timestamps, but only availability counts were retained; no event-to-presentation latency was collected.

host.swift:
Apple Swift version 6.4.2 (swiftlang-6.4.2.1.9 clang-2100.4.1.1)
Target: arm64-apple-macosx27.2.0

aggregation.cpu: Median of three process user-plus-system CPU percentages; one fully used core is 100%.
aggregation.latency: Nearest-rank quantiles pooled over 180 samples per scene/version; no confidence interval or statistical significance claim.
aggregation.counts: Per-run totals include only the measured CPU window; table counts and upload bytes use the median of three runs.

validation.canonical_gate: scripts/verify.sh exited 0; 389 Swift tests, 3 opt-in skips, no failures.
validation.local_browser_limit: Chromium and WebKit passed; existing Firefox startup failure (Could not find profile folder) triggered the configured local skip. Fresh CI Firefox qualification is outstanding.
validation.native_app: Debug and clean committed release builds, three-second startup smokes and ad-hoc signature checks passed. Release app stamp matches candidate_commit.
validation.staged_public_file_audit: Implementation audit passed before its commit. Final evidence index audit passed over 341 files.
validation.wasm: No Rust or WASM implementation changed in this round; committed provenance verified.

interpretation.accepted: Multi-pane process CPU reductions exceed the planned 15-20% gate in these workloads.
interpretation.tradeoff: Visible unfocused automatic refreshes now coalesce at about 30 Hz. Focused/local interaction stays immediate. Multi-pane p50 event-to-GPU latency increased by approximately 0.8-0.9 ms while pooled p95 decreased.
limits: Three short runs per version on one host, synthetic input, instrumented release testable modules.
No physical key-to-photon measurement, shipping-app comparison or fresh Ghostty benchmark.
CPU excludes producer child processes and WindowServer; this is not energy usage.
VT/grapheme throughput and browser performance are outside this change.
